objects.name: Analytic 1904
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an interactive desktop session Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP), Virtual Network Computing (VNC), or vendor remote console to an Human-Machine Interface (HMI) or engineering station from a source Internet Protocol (IP) addresses outside the approved Network Management System (NMS) Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) subnet, or from an account not in the approved operator/engineer list, where the session subsequently interacts with Industrial Control System (ICS) control elements. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.
